resources.string: Tour Max — L: %.1f° | R: %.1f° | Acc: +%.2fg | Brake: %.2fg

1. Main View (Gauge)
Shows your current lean angle in real-time.
- Colors: Green (up to 20°), Yellow (20°-35°), Red (over 35°).
- Peak Markers: Yellow (current curve, adjustable reset) and Blue (absolute tour maximum).
- Intelligent Auto-Zero: The app automatically recalibrates the zero-point during constant straight riding (>40km/h).

2. Calibration & Sensors
- Manual: Tap the gauge to set 0° manually.
- Performance: Optimized for 60 FPS and OLED battery saving (true black background).

3. Controls & Background Mode
- Background Recording: Thanks to the Foreground Service, tracking continues even if the app is minimized or the screen is off.
- Lock View: Fixes screen orientation.
- Settings: Change axis, language, export format, and sensor sensitivity.

4. Recording & Auto-Start
- Manual: Tap ⏺ Record.
- Auto-Idle: Long-press ⏺ Record. Starts tracking once your set speed threshold is reached.

5. Pro Export
- Formats: Choose between GPX (Calimoto-ready) and CSV (Excel/Data analysis).
- Efficiency: Redundant points are removed to keep files small while preserving track accuracy.

Safety first: Never operate the app while riding!
